# Image fixtures

`RGB_8__29x100.heif.b64` is the base64 representation of the legitimate HEIF
decoder fixture of the same name from the BSD-3-Clause-licensed
[`pillow-heif` project](https://github.com/bigcat88/pillow_heif/tree/master/tests/images/heif).
It exercises the real libheif decoder and is not represented as iPhone-originated.
